Step: 17 weeks + 2 days = 17×7 + 2 = 119 + 2 = 121 days.  
1394 is a common year (not divisible by 4 in Gregorian).  
From 1394-11-25, add 121 days:  
Nov 25 → Dec 31 = 36 days left in 1394.  
121 − 36 = 85 days into 1395.  
Jan 31 = 31 days, Feb 28 = 59 total, Mar 31 = 90 total → 85th day is 1395-03-26.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1395-03-26
